audiences.name: People the site is written for
audiences.pain: They are not sure Ignura is worth their time and want to see it working before they commit.
audiences.desire: A fast, honest look at what Ignura does and what it costs.

audiences.name: Careful comparers
audiences.pain: It is hard to tell options apart without clear pricing, process and proof.
audiences.desire: Straight answers on cost, timing and what is included.

angles.name: Walk through it live
angles.insight: A viewer judges a product faster by watching it used than by reading a description.
angles.whyItWorks: Screen walkthroughs show the real interface, so nothing has to be taken on trust. Grounded in "Browse the work by type" (/#work).

angles.name: Say the price out loud
angles.insight: Pricing is where people drop off. Reading the real tiers aloud removes the guesswork.
angles.whyItWorks: Straight talk on cost earns trust and filters for serious buyers. Grounded in "How a launch works and pricing" (/#how).

angles.name: Proof you can see
angles.insight: The site shows real examples instead of promises. Pointing at them is more credible than summarising them.
angles.whyItWorks: Reacting to evidence on screen feels like a recommendation, not a pitch. Grounded in "UGC content that doesn’t look like ads" (/work/ugc).

angles.name: What happens after you say yes
angles.insight: People hesitate when they cannot picture the process. Walking the steps makes it feel doable.
angles.whyItWorks: A step-by-step walkthrough answers "what am I signing up for" before the viewer asks. Grounded in "The four-week launch plan for a consumer app" (/blog/four-week-launch-plan).

angles.name: Answer the question everyone asks
angles.insight: FAQ questions are the objections viewers already have. Answering one on camera meets them where they are.
angles.whyItWorks: Objection-first content stops the scroll for viewers who are close to deciding. Grounded in "Read the FAQ" (/#faq).

creators.profile: Age 20 to 32, micro creator (5k to 50k followers) whose audience overlaps with Ignura's (launch studio for apps). Films screen walkthroughs with voiceover and is comfortable narrating without a script.
creators.whyThem: Credibility comes from visibly using the product, which fits the screen-recording angles.

creators.profile: Age 25 to 40, small but trusted audience (2k to 30k) that likes breakdowns of pricing and process. Talking-head with a calm, direct tone.
creators.whyThem: Viewers who compare options trust a creator who reads the details aloud.

creators.archetype: Peer who just went through it
creators.profile: Age 22 to 35, founder or builder who shares what they are working on. Works in POV and story formats.
creators.whyThem: A peer voice makes the product feel like a next step, not an ad.

dos: Show the real interface, using the supplied screenshots or your own recording of the live product.
Open with the hook in the first 2 seconds and add burned-in captions.
Read any quoted page copy exactly as written.
Say plainly that the post is sponsored.
donts: Do not present the site's own numbers, prices or view counts as your own results. Attribute them ("their site says").
Do not promise outcomes such as views, signups or revenue.
Do not mention features that are not in the must-show list.
Do not hide or bury the paid-partnership label.
deliverables: 5 vertical 9:16 videos, 25 to 35 seconds, with captions
Raw screen recording of the product for re-cuts
Two hook variants per video for A/B testing
Post links within 48 hours of publishing, for tracking
creatorBrief.disclosure: Label every post as an ad: use the platform's paid-partnership tool and add #ad. Disclose any payment or free access.

campaign.goal: Learn which angle, hook and creator pairing earns qualified visits to https://ignura.com/, then put more creators behind the winners.

phases.name: Test
phases.objective: Find the strongest hook and angle at small cost.
actions: Publish 5 scripts across tiktok, youtube-shorts, instagram-reels, linkedin, one per day, then repeat each with its alternate hook. Test matrix: hook (A/B per script) x creator x platform. Change one variable at a time, so finish both hooks on a script before changing creator or platform.
Keep every cut under 35 seconds with the same CTA, so only the hook and angle vary.
Review 3-second hold rate and link clicks at 24 and 72 hours.
Pause anything below the benchmark after 72 hours.

phases.name: Scale
phases.objective: Put more creators behind the winning hook and angle.
actions: Brief 2 to 3 more creators on the top script.
Re-cut the winner with two new hooks.
Cross-post winners to the other platforms.

phases.name: Always-on
phases.objective: Keep a steady flow of fresh cuts.
actions: Refresh hooks weekly from comments and questions.
Retire a creative when its 3-second hold rate falls.
